text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap-tap-tap-tap...!*)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, right, of course! Without even thinking about it,
it's totally natural that people wouldn't make as big a fuss over me as the others!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Because Teio-san was amazing!
Brusque-san was too!
I haven't run a race like that yet.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I'm getting ignored. If only
I could run a race like that right in front of them...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chaaan, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? That is..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond-san,
you're finally debuting this year.
The young lady of the Satono Group, at last!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Do you have any dreams? You're already looking ahead to next year, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. However,
I believe in taking things one step at a time,
so for now—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia... chan...
And she hasn't even debuted yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Right before the Classic Triple Crown.
Kitasan Black's achievements up to this point were in great shape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slowly but surely, her true strength has been rising.
At this rate, even the Classic Triple Crown might be...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can really pull this off...
choice_data_list: Huh, what do you mean properly?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown...
Will I really be able to entertain everyone?
Lately, there's something I've been feeling.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Before even talking about being strong or weak, I started wondering if I was just lacking something fundamental from the start."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That would be—the kind of "flashiness"
that catches everyone's eye...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san isn't just strong.
She's super cool,
and even just lightly stepping makes her stand out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan is the same. That brilliance of hers
is something she was born with, and people have always watched her.
Even before she started racing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“I don't have any of that, though.
I'm just ordinary—no one's watching me, no one expects anything from me.
And yet...”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Could someone like me really take center stage
in the Classics?
Could I really become an Umamusume who brings smiles to everyone's faces...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood what she was getting at.
Inevitably, some Umamusume receive the spotlight right from the start, while others don't.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Skill and glamour are not the same thing.
Even so—
choice_data_list: I think there's a chance, though.
I think there's a chance, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even for someone like me... really?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if she kept getting stronger,
she would surely catch someone's eye eventually.
Kitasan Black was steadily climbing the ladder.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“I'm not confident enough yet...
to make races like the 『Satsuki Sho』 or 『Japan Derby』 my goal, though...”
choice_data_list: Then I'll at least prepare for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all depends on how Kitasan Black is feeling.
For now, we set our sights on the autumn
St. Lite Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, we decided to at least prepare
for entering both the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(The Satsuki Sho, the Derby... Of course I want to run in them.
Trainer-san told me I could do it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: !? Th... That's...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One more rep, Brusqueman.
You're still rough around the edges.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have always been overly reliant on your decisive bursts since you were little. It's about time you controlled those legs you inherited from your mother with reason. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Brusqueman
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am…….

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Brusque-san... I see...
Not only does she have her Trainer, but Air Groove-san is sticking by her side too...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (From the same stable... An Umamusume born and raised in the same environment, who understands everything about me... Someone like that, for me...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Dia-chan and Teio-san are different. No, not just the two of them...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Right now, the Umamusume around me are all so kind, but they're still from a completely different world...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: W-W-Whaaaaaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, you are?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just a passing class representative,
Sakura Bakushin O!
O-Oh, and you are...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're Kitasan Black-san, right!
I can sense it somehow. Your heart is crying out to me for help!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeek? Bakushin O-san,
why all of a sudden?
Huh? W-Whaaaaat?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...! That's right!
I really could have used some help, but..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What made you feel that way?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"It's not about logic. It just clicked!
I feel an overwhelming sense of destiny!
Like, totally buzzing with it!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You were looking for something destined, right!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, probably...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's absolutely perfect!
And that is because—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the Class Representative! You're the Chief Helper!
When it comes to helping people, there couldn't be better comrades than us!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Class rep and boss... Wh-When you put it that way,
I'm starting to feel like that too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right, exactly.
You need a class rep to guide you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to lend a hand!
Don't you worry, for I am the class representative!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
For you to go that far for me...
In that case, please do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a splendid answer!
Then let us sprint through what lies ahead together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: From today on, we're two bodies with one soul—a Bakushin soul!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Your goal is the St. Lite Kinen?
Shall we pick up a few wins along the way?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Either way, there's nothing to do but train!
Here we go, Bakushin, Bakushiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeeees~! Bakushin, Bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen!
I found a truly reassuring ally!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later, I heard the whole story.
Kitasan Black, who had been feeling down, may have just found the perfect ally.
